lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule (October 2015 snapshot provided) across administrative units in Liberia. The data represents spatial classifications of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect impacts of underlying hazards such as drought. Geographic data was compiled in GeoJSON and KML formats with metadata on classification scale, scenario, and data source documentation.
